label: Total water storage anomaly (groundwater + soil + surface)
source: NASA/DLR GRACE & GRACE-FO, JPL mascon RL06.3 v04 CRI (TELLUS_GRAC-GRFO_MASCON_CRI_GRID_RL06.3_V4, PO.DAAC)

confidence.note: Satellite gravimetry: all water stored in a ~300 km region (groundwater, soil, rivers, snow) as cm of water vs the 2004–2009 mean. Shows the regional long-term trend, not a commune or field value. Typical 1σ uncertainty ≈ 2.1 cm. Gaps: GRACE ended mid-2017, GRACE-FO started mid-2018, and some single months are missing.
